name: Teak 2-Door Wardrobe
description: Spacious 2-door solid teak wardrobe featuring a full hanging section, multiple shelves, and three internal drawers with a lockable compartment. Built for long-lasting bedroom storage.
details: This handcrafted 2-door solid teak wardrobe combines timeless elegance with practical, well-organized storage for Sri Lankan bedrooms. The exterior features double panel doors fitted with modern long handles, individual door locks, and a decorative cornice top. Inside, the left compartment offers a sturdy wooden hanging rod and slatted shelf for folded clothes or luggage, while the right section includes spacious shelves and three built-in drawers—one with a dedicated key lock for valuables. Also fitted with an inner towel or tie rack on the right door for added convenience.
